profile.headline: Software Engineer II @ Atlassian
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Eliana — I graduated from Boston College with the class of 2024 with a major in Computer Science and a minor in Managing for Social Impact and the Public Good. 

I currently work as a Software Engineer on the Growth Acquisition (Experimentation) team at Atlassian, building user-facing experiences at the intersection of engineering and design.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
- Collaborated with design and product teams to enhance user experience by improving the clarity of a key button's label, resulting in a 30% reduction in discarded copied page drafts on Confluence Android mobile.
- Led the end-to-end software development cycle to successfully integrate a 'Copy Link' button into the Confluence Android mobile app, enhancing content sharing and collaboration capabilities.
- Gained hands-on experience in Android development, UX design, and cross-functional teamwork within an agile environment.
